sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Fireworks! is a game about linking and popping colored spheres to load the firework and launch it to the sky. Sounds simple, right? Well, there's a catch – the spheres are moving at different speeds, and you need to time your actions perfectly to pop them. The game features a variety of obstacles, including moving blocks, bombs, and other hazards that will try to ruin your plans.

As you progress through the game, the levels become increasingly challenging, with faster-paced action and a wider variety of obstacles to overcome. You'll need to develop a keen sense of timing and spatial awareness to succeed, as well as a dash of luck to get the best scores. The game also features a scoring system, where you earn points for each sphere you pop, with bonuses for achieving specific combos and streaks.

One of the standout features of Fireworks! is its use of physics and gravity. As you pop spheres, they'll stick to the firework, adding to its weight and momentum. If you time it just right, you can create massive explosions that will send your fireworks soaring to unprecedented heights. However, if you mishandle the timing, you might end up with a failed launch or even a catastrophic explosion.

In terms of gameplay mechanics, Fireworks! is incredibly polished, with smooth animations and responsive controls. Whether you're using a mouse, keyboard, or touch controls, the game responds seamlessly to your input, making it easy to play on a variety of devices.
